subject: One folder broke Copilot CLI. · Agent traps 12
title: One folder broke Copilot CLI. · Agent traps 12
description:
Fixed in Copilot CLI v1.0.73 (changelog).
One folder broke Copilot CLI. Fixed upstream. Sources:
https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/issues/4185
https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/tag/v1.0.73
script: One folder broke Copilot CLI. Add a directory with the add-dir flag, and every Claude subagent failed on the spot. A maximum of 4 blocks with cache_control may be provided. Found 5. One block over the limit. The parent agent got an empty answer. Update Copilot CLI, and Anthropic subagents keep working with extra directories. Exact version in the description. Subagent came back empty? Read its error, not the parent's. Subscribe — next agent trap.
